flags.title: Localised Single-Quadrant Channelling
flags.description: One quadrant is carrying a disproportionate share of the visible channeling signal.
flags.score_expr: min(dominant_quadrant_share / 0.42 if dominant_quadrant_share > 0 else 0.0, dominant_to_second_ratio / 1.35 if dominant_to_second_ratio > 0 else 0.0, 0.92 / max(1e-6, channel_spatial_entropy) if channel_spatial_entropy > 0 else 1.0, channel_moderate_frame_ratio / 0.20 if channel_moderate_frame_ratio > 0 else 0.0)
flags.when_expr: dominant_quadrant_share >= 0.42 and dominant_to_second_ratio >= 1.35 and channel_spatial_entropy <= 0.92 and channel_moderate_frame_ratio >= 0.20
flags.reason: One quadrant is repeatedly dominating the visible channeling pattern.

flags.title: One-Sided Extraction / Tamping Bias
flags.description: One side of the basket is extracting more strongly than the opposite side.
flags.score_expr: min(side_bias_strength / 0.22 if side_bias_strength > 0 else 0.0, side_dominance_ratio / 1.35 if side_dominance_ratio > 0 else 0.0, channel_moderate_frame_ratio / 0.18 if channel_moderate_frame_ratio > 0 else 0.0)
flags.reason: Adjacent quadrants on one side are consistently stronger than the opposite side.

flags.title: Global High Channelling / Unstable Puck
flags.description: Channeling appears broadly distributed across the basket rather than confined to one location.
flags.score_expr: min(channel_mean_norm / 2.5 if channel_mean_norm > 0 else 0.0, channel_high_frame_ratio / 0.25 if channel_high_frame_ratio > 0 else 0.0, channel_spatial_entropy / 0.90 if channel_spatial_entropy > 0 else 0.0)
flags.when_expr: channel_mean_norm >= 2.5 and channel_high_frame_ratio >= 0.25 and channel_spatial_entropy >= 0.90 and dominant_quadrant_share <= 0.40
flags.reason: Channeling stays high across much of the basket rather than staying localised.

flags.title: Likely Under-Extraction
flags.description: The shot is fast and blonding arrives early, suggesting low resistance and short contact time.
flags.score_expr: min(18.0 / max(1e-6, shot_time_s) if shot_time_s > 0 else 0.0, blond_rate / 0.12 if blond_rate > 0 else 0.0, 0.35 / max(1e-6, blond_60_norm) if blond_60_norm not in (None, 0.0) else 1.0)
flags.when_expr: shot_time_s <= 18.0 and ((blond_60_norm is not None and blond_60_norm <= 0.35) or blond_rate >= 0.12)
flags.reason: The shot is short and blonding arrives early.

flags.title: Likely Over-Extraction
flags.description: The shot is long and blonding is delayed, suggesting high resistance and long contact time.
flags.score_expr: min(shot_time_s / 35.0 if shot_time_s > 0 else 0.0, 0.60 / max(1e-6, blond_rate) if blond_rate > 0 else 1.0, blond_60_norm / 0.60 if blond_60_norm is not None else 0.0)
flags.when_expr: shot_time_s >= 30.0 and ((blond_60_norm is not None and blond_60_norm >= 0.55) or blond_rate <= 0.05) and channel_mean_norm < 2.0 and flag_score('global_high_channeling_unstable_puck') < 0.95
flags.reason: The shot is long, blonding is delayed, and channeling is not the dominant issue.

flags.title: Uneven Extraction
flags.description: The shot runs long while channeling remains elevated, pointing to uneven flow through the puck.
flags.score_expr: min(shot_time_s / 35.0 if shot_time_s > 0 else 0.0, channel_mean_norm / 2.0 if channel_mean_norm > 0 else 0.0, flag_score_max('localized_single_quadrant_channeling', 'one_sided_extraction_bias', 'global_high_channeling_unstable_puck'))
flags.reason: The shot runs long while channeling remains materially elevated.

flags.title: Choked / Restricted Flow
flags.description: Flow appears restricted with a long shot, weak blonding progression, and low visible channeling.
flags.score_expr: min(shot_time_s / 35.0 if shot_time_s > 0 else 0.0, 1.0 / max(1e-6, channel_mean_norm + 1e-6), 0.35 / max(1e-6, blonding_change + 1e-6), max(0.25 / max(1e-6, flow_start_confidence + 1e-6), flow_start_s / 4.0))
flags.when_expr: shot_time_s > 35.0 and channel_mean_norm < 1.0 and blonding_change < 0.35 and (flow_start_confidence < 0.25 or flow_start_s >= 4.0)
flags.reason: The shot is long but the visible flow and blonding progression stay muted.

flags.title: Gushing / Low Resistance Flow
flags.description: The shot runs quickly with strong blonding progression but without strong localised channeling.
flags.score_expr: min(18.0 / max(1e-6, shot_time_s) if shot_time_s > 0 else 0.0, blond_rate / 0.12 if blond_rate > 0 else 0.0, 2.0 / max(1e-6, channel_mean_norm + 1e-6))
flags.reason: The shot runs fast with strong blonding progression but without extreme localised channeling.

flags.title: Dry-Zone / Dead-Zone Detection
flags.description: One quadrant stays unusually quiet while the rest of the basket extracts more actively.
flags.score_expr: min(0.12 / max(1e-6, weakest_quadrant_share + 1e-6), 0.35 / max(1e-6, weakest_to_mean_other_ratio + 1e-6), channel_moderate_frame_ratio / 0.18 if channel_moderate_frame_ratio > 0 else 0.0)
flags.reason: One quadrant stays much quieter than the rest of the basket.
